shape.text: Grafana Cloud's agent-observability guide says tokens start with glc_, and the private data source connect learning path says the value must begin with glc_. The learning path's wording says the token name, which its context shows to mean the value.

After the prefix comes a base64-alphabet body (letters, digits, plus and slash) of at least 32 characters. It is the base64 of a JSON object, so in practice it starts eyJ, and padding equals signs are not part of the matched grammar.

unresolved.reason: Only scanner rules supply the alphabet, the 32-character floor and the eyJ observation, and the contract holds that corroboration as an unresolved claim; Grafana states no body.

openQuestions.text: Is there an upper bound on the length of the body?

unresolved.reason: One scanner rule caps the body at 400 characters and another uses a narrower range beginning eyJ; no provider text settles the bound.
